title.zh: Bithumb Says Hackers Accessed Internal System, Leaking Personal Data
title.en: Bithumb Says Hackers Accessed Internal System, Leaking Personal Data

current_state.zh: Bithumb disclosed that an unauthorized party accessed its internal mobile groupware system and leaked personal information, with the exchange investigating whether customer data was among the exposed material as South Korean authorities inspect breaches also reported by Daishin Securities and Mirae Asset Global Investments.
current_state.en: Bithumb disclosed that an unauthorized party accessed its internal mobile groupware system and leaked personal information, with the exchange investigating whether customer data was among the exposed material as South Korean authorities inspect breaches also reported by Daishin Securities and Mirae Asset Global Investments.
